attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as DHCP server on its private eth1/lan2 interface (10.200.20.0/24), which connects to node2 and node3's enp8s0 NICs. Added a static UCI dhcp host reservation binding node2's enp8s0 MAC to 10.200.20.50, while node3 draws from the general pool (10.200.20.100-150). Verified node2 consistently receives 10.200.20.50 across lease renewals and reboots, while node3 receives a distinct pool address (10.200.20.131) that also persists. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes sequentially (node1 first as router, then node2, then node3), each showing a changed boot_id and fully recovered DHCP/router state.
